status: design reference; no Blender scene created

source.provenance: Owner-supplied visual reference; original remains local and untracked.
source.role: Primary reference for 3D geometry, material, lighting and object vocabulary.
source.extraction_method: Manual visual interpretation. Geometry, shaders, lighting and camera cannot be recovered exactly from one raster image.

observed.style: Playful retro workstation sculpture with glossy/translucent industrial parts, chunky beveled forms and a floating assembly.

objects.description: Thick orange/yellow beveled monitor housing with inset black curved screen and cyan terminal-like lettering.
Curved cream tray, tall gray/white keycaps and one orange accent key.
Large sculpted white arrow beside the monitor.
Glossy red/orange block-like handheld accessory with white lower detail and lettering.
Thick coiled cream cable with rounded cross section.
Stacked orange rounded square tiles with an embossed smiling graphic.
Pale rounded disk behind the monitor.

materials_visual_inference: Colored translucent resin or polished plastic appearance
observed.lighting_visual_inference: Broad soft studio light, bright upper-left highlights, gentle reflections and local contact shadows.
observed.camera_visual_inference: Elevated three-quarter product view with limited perspective distortion.
observed.inference_note: Material classes, camera and light placement are interpretations, not verified scene properties.

project_adaptation.status: Proposed Blender-friendly art direction; not a .blend file or a scene import format.
change: Replace dominant orange/red with Anduin blue and supporting mint
Use source/review symbols rather than arbitrary terminal text
Simplify accessory count for a clean hub
Use a shared base and camera for all modules
avoid: Android mascot or dominant Android green
Real contract text baked into textures

blender_scene_plan.implementation_state: Specification only; no Blender commands executed.
component_structure: One named root transform per module
Separate principal object, optional prop and base
Same object scale family and local origin

shared_materials.appearance: Polished blue resin with restrained transmission
Supporting mint resin; less area than blue
Soft matte white polymer for documents, bases and keycaps

blender_scene_plan.shader_note: All numeric ranges are optional proposed starting points, not extracted reference values or tested settings. Tune after a real scene exists.
blender_scene_plan.camera: Shared mildly elevated three-quarter orthographic or long-lens view, with front-on 2D labels composited separately.
lights: One broad soft key from upper left
Restrained rim/reflection source only where needed
blender_scene_plan.stage: Simple cool light-blue studio ground with two ordered module lanes; matching white bases and soft contact shadows.
cleanliness: At most one secondary functional prop, except the integrated CRT assembly
No baked UI typography or invented logo meshes
Keep source pages and exact UI copy in the future 2D layer
future_delivery_candidates: Optional lightweight web asset exports after runtime decisions
blender_scene_plan.delivery_note: Future candidates are not deliverables of this design-only task.

motion_specification.state: Proposed behavior only; no animations rendered or implemented.
motion_specification.exit: Return to neutral pose without bouncing.
motion_specification.click: Open the corresponding functional section, retaining document/version context.
motion_specification.focus: Same selection information as hover, with visible focus ring.
motion_specification.reduced_motion: Static selection treatment; no spatial movement.
motion_specification.separation: Move only the 3D root or functional prop; keep label and click target stationary.
